demo-notes-rail.html:
The Notes section lists short scraps that are not full posts. This sample post only points at that rail.

Open Notes to see the two invented notes shipped with the demo. They have dates and text, and one carries a link to example.org.

demo-paper.html:
High tide covers the blank paper for a moment; when it falls, the page is still blank.

Neutral filler about tides and letters. No person, no real harbour, no borrowed wording from any live post.

demo-sections.html:
这篇样本把左侧分区再点名一次：精选、全部推送、笔记、标签、归档、线索、搜索。

精选来自示范包里的分组名单；其余分区由索引里的文章、笔记、标签与线索字段驱动。全部内容都是为公开仓库虚构的。

demo-threads.html:
This sample is the third post in the demo thread named Opening the demo.

Choose Threads in the rail, open that thread name, and the three linked samples appear together. The thread is invented for the demo; it is not a real series from a live site.
